freezeAuthorization: Root explicitly authorized comparison after frozen Solver and independent QA.

comparisons.rootCause: MATCH: OSC hyperlink terminator recognizer allowed BEL but not ESC-backslash.
comparisons.behavior: PASS for original issue: ESC-backslash hyperlinks match and strip correctly, preserving visible text. Existing BEL behavior retained. Historical patch additionally supports C1 ST U+009C, absent from original issue requirements and replay patch.
comparisons.tests: Solver adds exact matching, stripping, onlyFirst and adjacent ANSI tests. QA424AVA/XO/tsd plus12mixed terminator tests pass. Auditor confirms BEL and ESC-backslash behavior; U+009C differential documented rather than retroactively expanding acceptance.
comparisons.scope: Both change recognizer and tests. Replay is narrower: requested ESC-backslash support only; accepted solution generalizes all3terminators.
comparisons.simplicity: Focused inline alternation, no API change; historical solution factors3terminators into named constant.
comparisons.regressions: No observed regressions within tested issue scope. C1-ST remains an existing limitation, not a regression introduced by this patch.

limitations: Not behaviorally identical to accepted fix: C1 ST U+009C remains unsupported.
